data.one_liner: Routes data fetching through local providers before Supabase with offline caching.
data.what_it_does: It provides an Offline-First repository domain that integrates Supabase with local SQLite storage. It enables offline request queuing, automatic local caching, and synchronization with Supabase realtime events.
use_when: You are building an app with Supabase that requires offline data access and caching.
You want automatic synchronization with Supabase realtime changes using a local-first architecture.
avoid_when: You are not using Supabase as your backend.
Your application does not require local persistence or offline capabilities.
strengths: Seamless offline-first caching with SQLite for Supabase apps.
Built-in offline request queue that retries requests upon reconnection.
Supports Supabase realtime events to keep local data synchronized.
weaknesses: Brittle offline queue configuration when ignoring core Supabase paths like auth or storage.
Complex nullable associations can cause PostgREST to return unfiltered or all results.
Requires code generation and specific repository boilerplate.
data.setup_notes: Requires databaseFactory setup, model dictionary generation using build_runner, and defining models extending OfflineFirstWithSupabaseModel.

alternatives.name: supabase
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to use the official Supabase Dart client directly without an offline-first local SQLite cache layer.

alternatives.name: cloud_firestore
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you are using Firebase Firestore instead of Supabase for your backend and offline database needs.
